title: Quote-of-the-day route has no included regression coverage
reasoning: The owned route exposes patristic-quotes/quote-of-the-day/, but the included associated tests exercise other feature areas such as devotionals and fasts rather than asserting that this URL resolves or returns the expected quote-of-the-day response. That leaves the route vulnerable to regressions in URL ordering, naming, or view wiring without any included test failing.
recommendation: Add a focused URL/API test for /api/patristic-quotes/quote-of-the-day/ that creates the minimum required PatristicQuote data, calls the endpoint, and asserts the status code and response contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The provided context tests cover Armenian text scraping, Bible API behavior, devotionals, email tasks/templates, fast views, and feast admin icon actions, but none exercise the patristic quote-of-the-day endpoint.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test module or extend an existing patristic quote test to call self.client.get('/api/patristic-quotes/quote-of-the-day/') and assert the selected quote payload, including behavior when no quote is available.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering the route and expected response contract.
